title: Chinese Wonton Dumplings with Fenugreek
description: A traditional Chinese dish with a twist of fenugreek. Wonton wrappers are filled with a mixture of ground meat, fenugreek, and spices, then steamed to perfection.

ingredients.name: Wonton wrappers
ingredients.notes: available in most Asian grocery stores

ingredients.name: Ground pork
ingredients.notes: can be substituted with ground chicken or beef

ingredients.name: Fenugreek leaves
ingredients.notes: optional, but adds a unique flavor

instructions: 1. In a large mixing bowl, combine ground pork, fenugreek leaves, soy sauce, sesame oil, salt, and pepper. Mix well until all ingredients are fully incorporated.
2. Lay a wonton wrapper on a clean surface. Place a tablespoon of the pork mixture in the center of the wrapper.
3. Dip your finger in water and run it along the edges of the wrapper. Fold the wrapper into a triangle by bringing the two opposite corners together to form a point.
4. Press the edges together to seal the wonton. Repeat with the remaining wrappers and filling.
5. In a large pot or steamer basket, place a steamer insert with a layer of parchment paper. Arrange the wontons in a single layer, leaving space between each dumpling.
6. Steam the wontons over boiling water for 8-10 minutes, or until they are cooked through.
7. Serve the wontons hot with your favorite dipping sauce. Garnish with chopped scallions, if desired.
8. Enjoy your delicious Chinese wonton dumplings with fenugreek!
